"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))

"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))

+++ b/tests/test_user_initials.py
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+from app.api import handlers
+
+
+def test_user_initials_ok():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"initials": "AL"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_ok_last_word():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"initials": "LT"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_collapses_whitespace(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        handlers.users,
+        "get_user",
+        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "  Grace   Brewster   Hopper  "},
+    )
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"initials": "GH"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_single_word(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        handlers.users,
+        "get_user",
+        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "Prince"},
+    )
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"initials": "P"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_missing_id():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_non_string_id():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_non_digit_id():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_not_found():
+    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "99"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
